description: eight steamed Nepali chicken momo dumplings, round pleated tops, with a small bowl of red tomato achar dipping sauce
Nepali chicken jhol momo, steamed dumplings sitting in a thin orange-brown spiced sesame-tomato soup, topped with chopped coriander
Nepali street-style chicken chowmein, stir-fried noodles with shredded chicken, cabbage, carrot and spring onion
Himalayan chicken thukpa, noodle soup with shredded chicken, spinach, carrot and a clear golden broth
vessel: in a deep ceramic bowl with a steel spoon

description: a Nepali vegetarian dal bhat thali: mound of white rice, yellow dal in a small bowl, mixed vegetable curry, saag greens, potato tarkari, tomato achar, papad and a lemon wedge
vessel: on a round steel thali plate with small steel bowls

description: Newari chatamari, a thin crisp rice-flour crepe topped with spiced minced meat, egg, onion and coriander, cut into wedges
three Newari yomari, fig-shaped steamed rice-flour dumplings with a pointed tip, glossy white, one cut open to show chaku and sesame filling
Nepali sel roti, a ring-shaped golden-brown crisp fried rice-flour bread, stacked three high
Newari buff choila, spicy grilled buffalo meat pieces mixed with ginger, garlic, chilli, fenugreek and mustard oil, with chopped coriander
Nepali chicken sekuwa, charcoal-grilled marinated chicken pieces on skewers with red onion and lemon wedges
Nepali chatpate street snack, puffed rice mixed with chopped onion, tomato, green chilli, coriander, peanuts, lemon and spices
vessel: in a rolled paper cone and a small steel bowl

description: Nepali panipuri, six crisp hollow puri shells filled with chickpea and potato, with a glass of green spiced mint water
two golden fried triangular vegetable samosas, one broken to show a spiced potato and pea filling, with green chutney
chicken biryani, saffron-tinted long-grain basmati rice layered with spiced chicken pieces, fried onion and mint, with a small bowl of raita
paneer butter masala, cubes of paneer in a creamy orange tomato gravy with a swirl of cream and coriander
vessel: in a copper karahi bowl, with a side of butter naan

description: Nepali milk tea (chiya), creamy light brown masala tea with a thin skin of milk
vessel: in a small glass cup on a saucer, with steam rising

description: mango lassi, thick golden yellow yoghurt drink with a mint leaf and a few mango cubes on top
vessel: in a tall clear glass with a steel straw

description: a chicken burger with a sesame bun, crispy chicken patty, lettuce, tomato and sauce, with a few fries on the side
a whole margherita pizza with melted mozzarella, tomato sauce and basil leaves, one slice slightly pulled away
vessel: on a round metal pizza tray

description: three glossy dark-brown gulab jamun in light sugar syrup, garnished with pistachio slivers
